# Hodges & Co. Studios

Independent software, AI and trading technology studio based in Accra, Ghana.
We build for clients or guide clients through building their own products.

Services include websites, applications, APIs, business portals, AI assistants,
automation, MetaTrader bots and TradingView indicators. Trading tools require
testing and risk controls; they do not guarantee returns.

Project estimates follow individual scope review. No fixed universal price is
published. Use the contact page for private Telegram enquiries or the form.

- Studio: https://ohwpstudios.org/about
- Services: https://ohwpstudios.org/sitemap-pages
- Project brief: https://ohwpstudios.org/estimate-project
- Contact: https://ohwpstudios.org/contact
- Published guides: https://ohwpstudios.org/blog
- Current guide index: https://ohwpstudios.org/llms.txt

The linked website is the authoritative source. Private client and admin data
are not part of these public resources.
